scope: Explicit unit-bearing substitutions in question prose, enforced by content-translation-validation and hence i18n:content/lint
units: SI and binary byte units, including French octet aliases
contract: Compare recognized numeric quantities when both fields contain the same number of distinct quantities. This is an additional deterministic gate; all other numerical meaning remains in per-question AI semantic review.
notExhaustive: scale-word conversions such as 8億 to 800 million
clock formatting such as 19時 to 7 p.m.
initialDiagnostic: Raw digit matching misidentified legitimate written numerals, scale words, dates and clock formats. Those translations were not changed to satisfy a lexical check. Adopted unit-bearing semantic normalization instead.
